minutes.headline: Finance Committee voted 3-2 to recommend disapproval of using stabilization funds for an ambulance and dump trucks.
minutes.summary: At a public hearing on the special town meeting warrant, the committee heard from the select board chair, police chief, school superintendent and Parks Commission, then voted a recommendation on each article. The main dispute was whether to fund the vehicles from stabilization and return ARPA money to the select board. The roof repair and primary school air conditioning articles were recommended 4-1, two articles were deferred, and the rest were recommended or found to have no direct financial impact.

public_comment.topic: Wants the stabilization fund kept for big-ticket items and notes ambulances are getting more use.
Supported the roof repair at the TC Passos building, citing moisture and past neglect.

votes.motion: Recommend approval of article A without a fixed number.

topics.topic: Articles I and F: stabilization funds for vehicles; TC Passos roof

what_happened.line: The Finance Committee voted 3-2 to recommend disapproval of article I, which would use stabilization funds for an ambulance and dump trucks.
The committee voted 4-1 to recommend approval of article A without a fixed number.
At the public hearing on the special town meeting warrant, the committee heard from the select board chair, police chief, school superintendent and Parks Commission.
One resident asked that stabilization be kept for big-ticket items; another supported the TC Passos roof repair, citing moisture and past neglect.

why_it_matters: Special town meeting voters will be asked whether to pay for the ambulance and dump trucks from stabilization savings, and the committee's split recommendation leaves that question open.
Money taken from stabilization is not available for later large purchases, so the vote affects what the town has in reserve.
